subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the suitable option.

I drove back to the town and began to retrace the route, taking frequent __________ at the map.
solution:
The correct answer is '**glances**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**glances**" means quick looks or brief views. (झलक या तिरछी नज़र)
 
• The phrase “taking frequent glances at the map” logically conveys that the person kept quickly looking at the map while trying to retrace the route.
 
• This is a common collocation in English, often used in contexts involving checking directions or keeping an eye on something intermittently.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *I drove back to the town and began to retrace the route, taking frequent glances__ at the map.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Fences (बाड़)**: Physical barriers, irrelevant in the context of looking at a map.
 
• **Bounces (उछाल)**: Sudden movements up and down, not related to viewing something.
 
• **Winces (सिकुड़ना)**: A facial expression of pain or discomfort, unsuitable here.
